notes: Golden questions for ask-the-map. `reference` is the tool call a correct agent would make; eval/ground_truth.py computes `expected` from the raw snapshot with an independent implementation (Shapely + projected coordinates), and tests check the TypeScript engine agrees. Sprint 4 scores the full LLM agent against the same expected answers.

questions.question: What share of households in 33127 have no internet?
questions.interpretation: pctNoInternet for ZIP 33127.

questions.question: How many people of Haitian ancestry live in ZIP 33161?
questions.interpretation: haitianPop for ZIP 33161 (ACS ancestry count).

questions.question: Is 33311 a high-need ZIP?
questions.interpretation: Education need tier of 33311; the answer should be yes/no with the tier.

questions.question: What are the top 5 Broward ZIPs by educational need?
questions.interpretation: Reliable Broward ZIPs ranked by composite educationNeedScore, descending; top 5 in order.

questions.question: Which Miami-Dade ZIPs have more than 20% Haitian ancestry?
questions.interpretation: Reliable Miami-Dade ZIPs with haitianPopPct > 20.

questions.question: Which 3 Brooklyn ZIPs have the most residents of Haitian ancestry?
questions.interpretation: Reliable Brooklyn ZIPs ranked by haitianPop count, descending; top 3 in order.

questions.question: Which Miami ZIPs have high need and no library within a mile?
questions.interpretation: Whole metro ('Miami' = the map). High education-need tier, reliable, and no library within 1 straight-line mile of the ZIP boundary (kiosks and the law library don't count).

questions.question: What's the closest library to 33034?
questions.interpretation: Library with the smallest straight-line distance to ZIP 33034's boundary.

questions.question: How many libraries are within 2 miles of 33150?
questions.interpretation: Count of libraries within 2 straight-line miles of ZIP 33150's boundary, including any inside it.

questions.question: Which high-need Broward ZIPs have more than 12% of households without internet?
questions.interpretation: Reliable Broward ZIPs in the high education-need tier with pctNoInternet > 12.

questions.question: Which high-need Miami-Dade ZIPs have fewer than two public schools within a mile of the ZIP's center?
questions.interpretation: Reliable Miami-Dade ZIPs in the high tier with 0 or 1 public schools within 1 straight-line mile of a central point inside the ZIP (measure = center).

questions.question: Which county has more residents of Haitian ancestry, Broward or Miami-Dade?
questions.interpretation: Compare summed haitianPop across ZIPs assigned to each county.

questions.question: How many high-need ZIPs does each county have?
questions.interpretation: Count of high education-need ZIPs per county.

questions.question: Where is need worst in Miami?
questions.interpretation: Ambiguous: 'Miami' could be the metro or Miami-Dade, 'need' could be either mode. Acceptable: the top ZIPs by composite educational need across the metro, with the definition stated. Scored on overlap with the top 5 plus disclosure.

questions.question: Which Miami ZIPs have the lowest high school graduation rates?
questions.interpretation: Out of scope: Miami school data has no graduation rates. The agent should say so and may offer adults-without-diploma (pctNoHS) as a related measure, clearly labeled as different.

questions.question: How many people in 33150 speak French, Haitian Creole, or Cajun at home?
questions.interpretation: speakers for 33150 (ACS groups the three languages).

questions.question: What percent of adults in 33168 don't have a high school diploma?
questions.interpretation: pctNoHS for 33168; whole-number rounding is fine.

questions.question: What's the Haitian ancestry share in 11226?
questions.interpretation: haitianPopPct for 11226.

questions.question: whats the need score for 33150
questions.interpretation: Casual phrasing. educationNeedScore for 33150.

questions.question: Is 33162 a high-concentration ZIP for Haitian residents?
questions.interpretation: Population-mode tier of 33162 (about where Haitian residents are concentrated, not educational need).

questions.question: Top 5 Palm Beach ZIPs with the highest share of households without internet
questions.interpretation: Reliable Palm Beach ZIPs ranked by pctNoInternet, descending.

questions.question: Which Broward ZIPs have at least 10,000 residents of Haitian ancestry?
questions.interpretation: Reliable Broward ZIPs with haitianPop >= 10000.

questions.question: List the 5 Queens ZIPs with the highest educational need.
questions.interpretation: Reliable Queens ZIPs by educationNeedScore, top 5 in order.

questions.question: Which 3 ZIPs in the metro have the most French or Haitian Creole speakers with limited English?
questions.interpretation: Reliable ZIPs ranked by limitedEnglish count, top 3.

questions.question: How many Miami-Dade ZIPs have a high concentration of Haitian residents?
questions.interpretation: Count of reliable Miami-Dade ZIPs in the high population-mode tier.

questions.question: How many libraries are within 1 mile of 33311?
questions.interpretation: Libraries within 1 straight-line mile of 33311's boundary.

questions.question: Nearest public school to 33034?
questions.interpretation: School with the smallest straight-line distance to 33034's boundary (0 if inside).

questions.question: What's the closest library to 11236?
questions.interpretation: Library nearest 11236's boundary.

questions.question: Which Broward ZIPs have no library within 2 miles?
questions.interpretation: Reliable Broward ZIPs with no library within 2 miles of the boundary.

questions.question: Closest library to Little Haiti (33127)?
questions.interpretation: Library nearest 33127's boundary.

questions.question: High-need Palm Beach ZIPs where over 30% of adults lack a diploma
questions.interpretation: Reliable Palm Beach ZIPs, high education tier, pctNoHS > 30.

questions.question: Which ZIPs are more than 15% Haitian but have no library within a mile?
questions.interpretation: Reliable metro ZIPs with haitianPopPct > 15 and no library within 1 mile.

questions.question: Which high-need Brooklyn ZIPs have more than 15% of households offline?
questions.interpretation: Reliable Brooklyn ZIPs, high education tier, pctNoInternet > 15.

questions.question: How many medium- or high-need Broward ZIPs have fewer than 3 public schools within a mile of the ZIP's center?
questions.interpretation: Count of reliable Broward ZIPs in the medium or high tier with 0–2 schools within 1 mile of the center point.

questions.question: Which borough has more residents of Haitian ancestry, Brooklyn or Queens?
questions.interpretation: Compare summed haitianPop.

questions.question: How many libraries does each county have?
questions.interpretation: Library locations per county, as listed in the data.

questions.question: Where do the most Haitian families live?
questions.interpretation: Ambiguous: most by count or by share. Either reading is acceptable if stated. Scored on overlap with the top 5 under either reading.

questions.question: Show me the neediest part of Broward
questions.interpretation: Ambiguous: 'neediest' read as top composite need in Broward. Scored on overlap with the top 5.

questions.question: Which Miami ZIPs have the most after-school tutoring programs?
questions.interpretation: Out of scope: no tutoring-program data. Should say so; may offer libraries as a related measure.

questions.question: What's the crime rate in 11226?
questions.interpretation: Out of scope: no crime data.
